rationale: The candidate reads as one dominant stepped mass across all four views, so the gesture is clear and the form is coherent in multiple views rather than only one. The silhouette is not merely code-minimum stepping; it has a continuous cascading logic and a decent profile resolution. However, for the neighborhood-living brief the public threshold is weak: the blue access edge is acknowledged only indirectly, with no strong carve, seam, court, or ground-level opening that clearly activates the frontage. The void logic is present as a notch/terrace trace, but it is too internal and too small to count as a strong public court. Overall the mass is plausible as a compact mixed neighborhood building, but it leans toward a sealed stepped object more than an actively grounded street building, so program fit does not hard-pass.
